A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PKPO research. All 23 pages of v4 and 30 pages of v5 are readable, including equations, figures, tables and appendices. The additional v5 material does not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original toy simulations and reinforcement-learning experiments on MATH, coding and ARC-AGI-1, including numerical results and additional analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v5 retains these original simulations and reinforcement-learning results in Section 5 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The reward transformations, gradient estimators, leave-one-out baselines and k-annealing procedure are unchanged. Sections 2–4 and Listing 1 retain the same method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Gaussian toy problem, MATH tasks, MBPP training with HumanEval evaluation, and easy ARC-AGI-1 subset. The added references and checklist introduce no evaluated datasets or scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the k_opt=1 baseline, Tang et al. [TZSM25], EntropyReg and the same toy gradient-estimator comparisons. Newly cited related works are not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Section 5 retains the model variants, n=16 completions, evaluation metrics, dataset splits, entropy-coefficient sweep and annealing switch after 1500 steps. The checklist supplies no new experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The estimator-variance comparison, baseline effects, k sensitivity, entropy and cumulative-solve analyses, annealing experiment and hard-task learning curves are unchanged in Section 5 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard errors from three runs with different seeds, and the same toy variance calculation using 10,000 estimates. The checklist explains the absence of detailed confidence intervals but adds no runs, intervals, tests or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–8 and the plotted experimental results are unchanged, including the GEMMA2-2B appendix results. No result entries, rankings or qualitative findings are added or removed.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, estimators, theorems and proofs in the main text and Appendix A are unchanged. The acknowledgment of corrections to Equations 14, 31 and 32 already appears in v4; only its footnote number changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution overview and conclusion retain the same claims about unbiased low-variance estimation, optimization for arbitrary k≤n, annealing and learning on hard problems. The added literature acknowledgment does not revise these stated contributions.

C2.justification: New checklist items 7–8 attribute limited confidence-interval reporting to computational cost and limited compute disclosure to organizational restrictions. These qualify reporting completeness; the interpretations of exploration, variance reduction and annealing remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The implementation in Appendix B and the hardware, timing and experimental details in Section 5.2 are unchanged. The checklist repeats the pointer to Listing 1 without adding technical specifications, reproduction instructions or resource access.

R1.justification: Related Literature now credits Koyamada et al. [KPKI22] for expected-maximum optimization under resetting, an unbiased policy gradient and an exploration mechanism. A footnote adds five extension references. The existing positioning relative to [TZSM25] is retained.

P1.justification: v5 locally expands Related Literature and appends a NeurIPS checklist after Appendix C. The existing scientific sections and appendices retain their wording and order, without extensive rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–8 and Listing 1 retain their displays. Added literature and references cause localized text and footnote reflow, while the appended checklist introduces numbered questions, answers and guideline lists.

improvement.justification: v5 improves attribution and research positioning by acknowledging earlier expected-maximum policy-gradient work and related extensions omitted from v4. The checklist adds reporting caveats but no substantive reproducibility information. With the theory, experiments and results unchanged, the overall quality gain is limited.
